verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekarasampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, itthiraso.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single taste that occupies a man’s mind like the taste of a woman.

verses.pali: Itthiraso, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The taste of a woman occupies a man’s mind.”
